svg.title: Who may change what (charter 0.4.19)
svg.desc: Owner acts by who may take them: the agent, the owner's delegate at each level (routine, answers, open), or only the owner; and the path an owner-only change takes from the agent to a commit.
svg.text: An agent proposes and hands over; the owner rules. Between them, the delegate takes what the owner's level allows, never more.
The delegate, if the level allows
rules and a model judge it,
then it commits as the owner's delegate
charter owner commit (after ! or in a terminal)
Pre-commit and CI still judge it
the switch lifts the owner-only check,

g.text: or

svg.text: the owner's delegate, by level (strict: none)

g.aria-label: Edit code inside the unit's perimeter
g.title: Edit code inside the unit's perimeter
g.text: Edit code inside the unit's perimeter
edit, then commit on a branch

g.aria-label: Write a unit; propose a decision or a change request
g.title: Write a unit; propose a decision or a change request
g.text: Write a unit; propose a decision or a change request
charter-unit, charter-decision skills

g.aria-label: Commit an upgrade's package files as the installer wrote them
g.title: Commit an upgrade's package files as the installer wrote them
g.text: Commit an upgrade's package files as the installer wrote them
charter-pkg upgrade, then commit

g.aria-label: Close an — owner: check line whose probe passes on re-run
g.title: Close an — owner: check line whose probe passes on re-run
g.text: Close an — owner: check line whose probe passes on re-run
the watcher reruns the probe

g.aria-label: Commit an upgrade's settings change, exactly as the installer writes it
g.title: Commit an upgrade's settings change, exactly as the installer writes it
g.text: Commit an upgrade's settings change, exactly as the installer writes it
charter handover --wait

g.aria-label: Transcribe the owner's own ruling: rule, approve, rail
g.title: Transcribe the owner's own ruling: rule, approve, rail
g.text: Transcribe the owner's own ruling: rule, approve, rail
charter handover --ask … --quote

g.title: Edit charter/rails.md or charter/scope.md
g.text: Edit charter/rails.md or charter/scope.md
edit, then charter handover

g.aria-label: Merge the owner's own reviewed pull request
g.title: Merge the owner's own reviewed pull request
g.text: Merge the owner's own reviewed pull request
/reviewPR, then handover --merge N

g.aria-label: Config (the level too), .charter/**, settings, CI workflow, split units, — owner: do|decide
g.title: Config (the level too), .charter/**, settings, CI workflow, split units, — owner: do|decide
g.text: Config (the level too), .charter/**, settings, CI workflow, split units, —
owner: do|decide
the owner's line: … owner commit

g.aria-label: Run a waiting chain's acts; resume a chain
g.title: Run a waiting chain's acts; resume a chain
g.text: Run a waiting chain's acts; resume a chain
charter owner run; /resume-chain ok

g.aria-label: Push, deploy, and every other commitment
g.title: Push, deploy, and every other commitment
g.text: Push, deploy, and every other commitment
the owner's word, in the session

svg.text: Other than installer-exact upgrades, config, settings and .charter/ edits, — owner: do or decide lines, and the level stay with the owner; the level is read from the default branch, and from GitHub, whichever is stricter.
Sources: package/.claude/rules/charter.md § What only the owner changes, § The owner's delegate; docs/design/owner-delegate.md § Levels.
